This release adds a Postgres-backed store and improves cron scheduling across daylight-saving changes. It also changes public options and package entry points; update integrations before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- Rename the worker timing option `stalledIntervalMs` to `stallCheckMs`. Migration: replace `stalledIntervalMs` with `stallCheckMs` in `WorkerOptions` (#351)
- Remove the CommonJS package entry point. Migration: use the ESM `import` entry point instead of `require` (#353)

## Features

- Add `PostgresStore`, exported from `quaykit/postgres` (#355)

## Fixes

- Fire cron jobs once after a daylight-saving time change (#357)

## Security

- Dashboard job name rendering. Upgrade to this release (#358)

## Performance

- Batch writes in `addBulk` (#360)","bump":null,"sections":null},{"tool":"finish","id":null,"version":"4.0.0","notes":"# quaykit 4.0.0

# quaykit 4.0.0

This release adds a Postgres-backed store and improves cron scheduling across daylight-saving changes. It also changes public options and package entry points; update integrations before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- Rename the worker timing option `stalledIntervalMs` to `stallCheckMs`. Migration: replace `stalledIntervalMs` with `stallCheckMs` in `WorkerOptions` (#351)
- Remove the CommonJS package entry point. Migration: use the ESM `import` entry point instead of `require` (#353)

## Features

- Add `PostgresStore`, exported from `quaykit/postgres` (#355)

## Fixes

- Fire cron jobs once after a daylight-saving time change (#357)

## Security

- Dashboard job name rendering. Upgrade to this release (#358)

## Performance

- Batch writes in `addBulk` (#360)

## Fixes

## Security

- Dashboard job name rendering. Upgrade to this release (#358)

## Performance

- Batch writes in `addBulk` (#360)
